salesforce-gmail.metaDescription: Connect Salesforce and Gmail with GAIA. Automatically log client emails to Salesforce deal and contact records, create leads from inbound email replies, and keep your CRM activity timeline complete without manual entry.
salesforce-gmail.intro:
Sales reps send and receive dozens of client emails every day in Gmail, but those emails rarely make it into Salesforce without a deliberate BCC to the CRM email address or a manual activity log. The result is a Salesforce record that understates contact frequency, misses key conversation threads, and fails to capture the email trail that might be critical for deal reviews or handoffs.

GAIA connects Salesforce and Gmail so every relevant client email is logged to the correct CRM record automatically. When a Gmail message is sent to or received from a Salesforce contact, GAIA logs the email as an activity on the contact and opportunity record. When a promising email reply arrives from an unknown address, GAIA can create a new lead in Salesforce so the prospect enters the pipeline immediately.

This integration is built for sales teams that want complete CRM activity timelines without requiring reps to remember to log emails, and for revenue operations teams who need accurate engagement data for pipeline analysis and forecasting.

useCases.title: Log Gmail emails to Salesforce contact records automatically
useCases.description: When a Gmail email is sent to or received from a Salesforce contact's email address, GAIA logs the email as an activity on the contact record with the subject, timestamp, and direction, keeping the CRM timeline complete.

useCases.title: Attach emails to Salesforce opportunity records

useCases.title: Identify unresponsive prospects from email gaps
useCases.description: GAIA monitors Gmail activity for Salesforce contacts and alerts the rep when a prospect has not replied to an email in a configurable number of days, prompting follow-up before the deal goes cold.

faqs.question: Does GAIA log every email or only emails to Salesforce contacts?
faqs.answer: By default, GAIA logs only emails where the sender or recipient matches a Salesforce contact or lead email address. You can also configure it to log emails from specific domains or Gmail labels.

faqs.question: Can GAIA attach the full email body to Salesforce or just a summary?
faqs.answer: GAIA logs the email subject, timestamp, direction, and a configurable amount of the body text to the Salesforce activity record. Full email bodies can be included if your Salesforce storage limits allow.

faqs.question: What happens when an email involves multiple Salesforce contacts?
faqs.answer: GAIA logs the email to all matching Salesforce contact records in the thread and associates it with the relevant open opportunity for each contact, ensuring no touchpoint is missed on multi-stakeholder deals.

salesforce-notion.intro:
Enterprise sales teams manage complex deals that require rich documentation — account strategies, stakeholder maps, competitive positioning, executive briefings — that cannot live inside Salesforce's structured fields. Notion is where this content gets written, but it stays disconnected from the live deal data in Salesforce. Account documents go stale, pipeline dashboards in Notion require manual updates, and new team members cannot find the strategic context built up during the deal cycle.

GAIA connects Salesforce and Notion so deal intelligence flows between CRM and knowledge base automatically. When a Salesforce opportunity is created, GAIA creates a Notion deal page from an account strategy template pre-populated with CRM data. As the deal progresses, GAIA updates the Notion page with stage changes and key metrics. When account strategies or meeting notes are added to Notion, GAIA can log key outcomes back to Salesforce.

This integration is designed for enterprise sales teams, strategic account managers, and revenue operations teams that manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals requiring both structured CRM tracking and rich collaborative documentation.

useCases.description: GAIA maintains a Notion database of Salesforce opportunities, keeping stage, value, close date, and rep fields synchronized so pipeline dashboards in Notion always reflect live CRM data.

useCases.description: GAIA pulls Salesforce contact records associated with an opportunity and populates the stakeholder map section of the Notion deal page, giving the account team a collaborative space to build relationship strategies.

useCases.title: Log Notion meeting notes to Salesforce activities
useCases.description: When a meeting notes section is updated on a Notion deal page, GAIA creates a corresponding activity note on the Salesforce opportunity, keeping the CRM timeline complete without requiring reps to log in two places.

useCases.title: Executive briefing generation
useCases.description: Before a high-value deal review, GAIA compiles a Notion executive briefing page pulling Salesforce deal data, activity history, and risk signals alongside the strategic notes from the Notion deal page.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create different Notion templates for different Salesforce deal types?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to select Notion page templates based on Salesforce opportunity type, record type, or product line, ensuring the right strategic framework is applied to each deal.

faqs.question: How often does GAIA sync Salesforce data to the Notion pipeline database?
faqs.answer: GAIA syncs on configurable intervals — real-time on stage changes, or on a scheduled basis for field updates. You can also trigger a manual sync on demand for a specific opportunity.

faqs.question: Can multiple team members collaborate on a Notion deal page while GAIA syncs CRM data?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA writes to specific structured sections of the Notion deal page — CRM-synced fields, activity logs — while leaving collaborative sections free for the account team to edit without conflict.

salesforce-asana.tagline: Create Asana projects from Salesforce opportunities and sync delivery back to CRM
salesforce-asana.metaTitle: Salesforce + Asana Automation - From Closed Deal to Delivery Project
salesforce-asana.metaDescription: Bridge sales and delivery with GAIA. Automatically create Asana projects when Salesforce deals close, sync project milestones back to CRM records, and keep account managers and delivery teams working from shared data.
salesforce-asana.intro:
Closing a deal in Salesforce is only the beginning — the delivery team then needs to execute on the commitments made during the sale. Without automation, the handoff from Salesforce to Asana is manual: someone copies deal details into a new project, assigns tasks by hand, and sets deadlines without referencing the contract dates in Salesforce. The delivery team starts every engagement with incomplete information.

GAIA automates the Salesforce-to-Asana handoff so delivery begins the moment a deal closes. When a Salesforce opportunity reaches Closed Won, GAIA creates a structured Asana project pre-populated with all relevant deal data — company name, scope, contract dates, assigned delivery lead — and assigns tasks based on your delivery playbook. As the project progresses, GAIA reports milestones back to Salesforce so the account team always knows where delivery stands.

This integration is critical for professional services teams, SaaS implementation teams, and any organization where closing a deal immediately creates structured project work that must be tracked in Asana.

useCases.title: Auto-create Asana projects from Salesforce Closed Won deals
useCases.description: When a Salesforce opportunity is marked Closed Won, GAIA immediately creates an Asana project from the appropriate delivery template, pre-fills account details, sets contract-aligned deadlines, and assigns the delivery team.

useCases.description: GAIA maps Salesforce deal fields — product, contract value, implementation timeline, primary contact — to Asana custom project fields so the delivery team has the sales context they need without CRM access.

useCases.title: Report Asana delivery milestones to Salesforce
useCases.description: When key Asana project milestones are completed, GAIA logs them as Salesforce activity records on the linked account and opportunity, giving account managers delivery status visibility in their CRM.

useCases.title: Alert account managers about at-risk deliveries
useCases.description: When an Asana project is flagged at-risk or falls behind schedule, GAIA creates a Salesforce task for the account owner to proactively communicate with the client and manage expectations.

useCases.title: Generate renewal opportunities from project completion
useCases.description: When an Asana project is marked complete, GAIA creates a new Salesforce opportunity for renewal or expansion, pre-populated with the account details and a renewal timeline based on the original contract.

faqs.question: Can GAIA select different Asana templates based on Salesforce deal attributes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Configure GAIA to select Asana templates based on Salesforce fields such as product line, contract size, or customer segment, so the right delivery structure is applied to each type of engagement.

faqs.question: What happens if a Salesforce deal is reopened after the Asana project has started?
faqs.answer: GAIA can detect deal stage reversals and notify the Asana project manager. The Asana project is not automatically deleted — a human decision is needed to pause, cancel, or continue delivery work.

faqs.question: Can account managers in Salesforce see Asana project task-level details?
faqs.answer: GAIA logs milestone-level updates to Salesforce rather than individual task details, keeping the CRM record high-level. Account managers can request a project summary from GAIA at any time for more detail.

salesforce-google-calendar.tagline: Sync sales calls and meetings with Salesforce CRM activities automatically
salesforce-google-calendar.metaTitle: Salesforce + Google Calendar Automation - Log Sales Meetings to CRM
salesforce-google-calendar.metaDescription: Connect Salesforce and Google Calendar with GAIA. Automatically log client meetings as CRM activities, create follow-up tasks from calendar events, and keep your Salesforce activity timeline complete without manual entry.
salesforce-google-calendar.intro:
Account executives and sales reps schedule and attend client meetings in Google Calendar every day, but those meetings only help the team if they are captured in Salesforce. Manual CRM logging is time-consuming and inconsistently done — reps log some meetings, forget others, and rarely capture enough detail for the next person who inherits the account to understand the relationship history.

GAIA connects Salesforce and Google Calendar so every client meeting is automatically recorded in the CRM with zero manual effort from the rep. When a Google Calendar event involves a Salesforce contact, GAIA creates the activity record, attaches meeting notes, and after the meeting generates follow-up tasks based on what was agreed. The Salesforce timeline becomes a complete, accurate record of all client touchpoints without relying on rep discipline.

This integration is essential for enterprise sales teams managing complex deal cycles, customer success managers with large books of business, and revenue operations teams that need accurate activity data for pipeline analysis and forecasting.

useCases.title: Log Google Calendar meetings as Salesforce activities
useCases.description: When a Google Calendar event includes a Salesforce contact's email address, GAIA automatically creates a meeting activity on the Salesforce contact and opportunity record with attendees, date, and duration.

useCases.title: Create Salesforce follow-up tasks after meetings
useCases.description: When a calendar meeting with a Salesforce contact ends, GAIA creates a follow-up task on the opportunity with a configurable due date, prompting the rep to send notes or take the next agreed action.

useCases.title: Attach pre-meeting research to Salesforce records
useCases.description: Before a scheduled meeting with a Salesforce contact, GAIA compiles a meeting brief from CRM data — deal stage, last activities, open tasks — and attaches it to the calendar event so the rep arrives prepared.

useCases.title: Identify deal engagement gaps
useCases.description: GAIA monitors Salesforce opportunities for contacts who have not had a calendar meeting scheduled in a configurable number of days and alerts the rep, ensuring high-value deals maintain appropriate meeting cadence.

useCases.title: Schedule Salesforce-informed follow-up meetings
useCases.description: When a Salesforce task requires a follow-up meeting, GAIA checks the rep's Google Calendar availability and the contact's suggested times to create a meeting invite automatically, reducing scheduling back-and-forth.

howItWorks.step: Connect Salesforce and Google Calendar to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Salesforce organization and Google Calendar accounts. GAIA matches calendar attendee email addresses to Salesforce contact and lead records automatically.

howItWorks.step: Configure logging rules and follow-up automation
howItWorks.description: Define which calendar events trigger Salesforce activity creation — by attendee domain, calendar, or event type — and set the follow-up task template that GAIA creates after each meeting.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps your CRM timeline complete
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Google Calendar for client meetings and logs them to Salesforce automatically, creating follow-up tasks and meeting briefs so your CRM accurately reflects every sales interaction.

faqs.question: Does GAIA log internal team meetings to Salesforce or only external client meetings?
faqs.answer: GAIA logs only meetings where attendees match Salesforce contact or lead email addresses by default, excluding internal team meetings from CRM activity logging to keep the timeline relevant.

faqs.question: Can GAIA handle calendar meetings where multiple Salesforce contacts attend?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA logs the meeting to all matching Salesforce contact records in the event and associates the activity with the relevant open opportunity for each contact.

faqs.question: What happens when a calendar meeting is cancelled after being logged to Salesforce?
faqs.answer: GAIA updates the Salesforce activity record to reflect the cancellation and can optionally create a reschedule task on the opportunity so the rep follows up to book a new time.

salesforce-drive.intro:
Los acuerdos enterprise generan mucha documentación (propuestas, NDA, SOW, contratos y enmiendas legales) que vive en Drive mientras el registro vive en Salesforce. Sin automatización, los comerciales buscan la última versión de una propuesta, y los enlaces en los registros quedan obsoletos cuando los archivos se mueven o renombran.

GAIA conecta Salesforce y Drive para tener la documentación siempre organizada y accesible desde el CRM. Cuando se crea una oportunidad, GAIA crea una carpeta estructurada para la cuenta. Cuando se crean o firman documentos, GAIA los adjunta al registro con el tipo y la versión correctos. Cuando se ejecuta un contrato, GAIA avanza la etapa automáticamente.

Esta integración es esencial para equipos enterprise con ciclos documentales complejos, equipos legales y de compras que necesitan trazabilidad de versiones y operaciones que necesitan accesibilidad automática en lugar de depender de hábitos individuales.

zoom-asana.tagline: Turn Zoom meeting action items into Asana tasks automatically
zoom-asana.metaTitle: Zoom + Asana Automation - Meeting Action Items to Tasks
zoom-asana.metaDescription: Connect Zoom and Asana with GAIA. Auto-create Asana tasks from Zoom meeting summaries, assign owners, set due dates, and ensure every action item gets tracked.
zoom-asana.intro:
Zoom meetings generate action items, but those action items are only as useful as the system that captures them. Without an automatic bridge, someone must manually review the recording or notes and create tasks in Asana — a step that gets skipped when everyone is busy.

GAIA listens to Zoom meeting summaries and transcripts, identifies action items, and creates Asana tasks with the right assignees and due dates before the call is even over. Your team leaves every meeting with a clear, tracked to-do list.

useCases.title: Auto-create Asana tasks from meeting action items
useCases.description: After a Zoom call ends, GAIA parses the meeting summary for action items and creates an Asana task for each one. Assignees and due dates from the conversation are applied automatically.

useCases.title: Link Zoom recording to the Asana project
useCases.description: GAIA attaches the Zoom recording URL to the relevant Asana project as a task or note. Team members can reference the recording directly from the Asana board without hunting through email.

useCases.title: Post meeting summary to Asana project updates
useCases.description: GAIA posts a formatted meeting summary — attendees, decisions, action items — as an Asana project status update so stakeholders who weren't on the call are immediately informed.

useCases.title: Create recurring tasks from recurring Zoom standups
useCases.description: For regular Zoom standups, GAIA generates recurring Asana tasks each session based on blockers and commitments raised. Sprint tracking stays current without manual entry after each meeting.

howItWorks.step: Connect Zoom and Asana to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Zoom account and Asana workspace. Link specific recurring Zoom meetings to the Asana projects they relate to.

howItWorks.step: Configure task creation preferences
howItWorks.description: Set which sections action items land in, how due dates are inferred, and whether GAIA should tag assignees based on who was mentioned in the meeting.

howItWorks.step: GAIA converts meetings into trackable tasks
howItWorks.description: After each Zoom call, GAIA processes the summary and populates Asana automatically. Your team leaves meetings knowing every commitment is already captured.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require Zoom AI Companion or a specific Zoom plan?
faqs.answer: GAIA works with Zoom's meeting summary and transcript features, which are available on Zoom Business and above. If your plan doesn't include summaries, GAIA can use the raw transcript instead.

faqs.question: How does GAIA determine who to assign tasks to in Asana?
faqs.answer: GAIA matches names mentioned in the meeting summary or transcript to Asana members in the linked workspace. You can review and adjust assignments before they are finalized.

faqs.question: Can GAIA handle meetings with multiple Asana projects?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can map a single Zoom meeting to multiple Asana projects, and GAIA will route action items to the correct project based on labels or keywords in the meeting notes.

zoom-linear.tagline: Post Zoom sprint summaries to Linear issues and keep engineering on track
zoom-linear.metaTitle: Zoom + Linear Automation - Sprint Meeting Summaries to Issues
zoom-linear.metaDescription: Connect Zoom and Linear with GAIA. Auto-post sprint meeting summaries to Linear, create issues from action items, and keep your engineering cycle updated after every call.
zoom-linear.intro:
Engineering sprint meetings happen in Zoom, but the decisions and commitments made there need to live in Linear where the actual work is tracked. When that bridge is manual, sprint issues go un-updated, blockers stay undocumented, and the Linear board drifts from reality.

GAIA connects Zoom and Linear so sprint summaries are automatically posted to the relevant Linear cycle, and action items become Linear issues with proper assignees and priority. Your Linear board stays accurate after every sprint ceremony without anyone doing data entry.

useCases.title: Post sprint retrospective notes to Linear cycle
useCases.description: After a Zoom retro, GAIA formats the discussion into a structured update and posts it to the active Linear cycle. The team has a searchable record of every retro without manual documentation.

useCases.title: Create Linear issues from Zoom standup blockers
useCases.description: Blockers raised during a Zoom standup are automatically converted into Linear issues by GAIA. Each issue is assigned to the person who raised the blocker and linked to the current sprint.

useCases.title: Update Linear issue status from Zoom planning decisions
useCases.description: When a Zoom planning call moves issues between sprints or changes priorities, GAIA applies those decisions in Linear automatically. The board reflects planning outcomes instantly.

useCases.title: Attach Zoom recording links to Linear project updates
useCases.description: GAIA adds the Zoom recording URL to the relevant Linear project as a comment so engineers can replay any part of the planning or retro discussion directly from their issue tracker.

howItWorks.step: Connect Zoom and Linear to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Zoom account and Linear workspace. Map recurring Zoom sprint meetings to the corresponding Linear teams and cycles.

howItWorks.step: Define what gets created or updated in Linear
howItWorks.description: Choose whether GAIA creates new issues, updates existing ones, or posts cycle comments based on meeting type — standup, planning, or retro.

howItWorks.step: GAIA updates Linear after every sprint meeting
howItWorks.description: Following each Zoom call, GAIA processes the summary and applies changes to Linear automatically. Sprint ceremonies produce immediate, traceable outcomes.

faqs.question: Can GAIA distinguish between different sprint ceremony types?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA identifies meeting type by name or by the Zoom meeting ID you configure. Standups, planning sessions, and retros each trigger different Linear actions.

faqs.question: Will GAIA create duplicate Linear issues if the same blocker is mentioned twice?
faqs.answer: GAIA deduplicates by checking for existing open issues with similar titles before creating new ones. If a match is found, it adds a comment rather than a new issue.

faqs.question: Does this work with Linear's cycle (sprint) feature specifically?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA posts summaries and creates issues within the active Linear cycle. If no cycle is active at meeting time, GAIA queues the items for the next cycle or adds them to the backlog.

zoom-jira.tagline: Log Zoom sprint meeting summaries directly to Jira sprints and epics
zoom-jira.metaTitle: Zoom + Jira Automation - Sprint Summaries to Jira
zoom-jira.metaDescription: Connect Zoom and Jira with GAIA. Auto-log Zoom sprint meeting outcomes to Jira, create issues from action items, and keep your Jira board current after every ceremony.
zoom-jira.intro:
Sprint ceremonies in Zoom generate commitments, decisions, and blockers that should live in Jira — but when the meeting ends, the notes often stay in someone's notebook or a shared doc that nobody reads. Jira issues go un-updated and sprint boards drift from what was actually discussed.

GAIA closes this gap by processing Zoom meeting summaries and logging outcomes directly to the corresponding Jira sprint. Action items become Jira issues, blockers get flagged, and sprint updates are posted before the team has even closed their laptops.

useCases.title: Create Jira issues from Zoom meeting action items
useCases.description: GAIA parses Zoom call summaries for action items and creates Jira issues in the active sprint. Each issue includes the description, assignee, and due date captured from the meeting.

useCases.title: Post sprint planning outcomes to Jira epics
useCases.description: After a Zoom planning session, GAIA logs the scope decisions and story point commitments as Jira epic comments. Product managers have a clear record of what was committed and why.

useCases.title: Flag Jira blockers surfaced in Zoom standups
useCases.description: Blockers mentioned in a Zoom standup trigger GAIA to set the Blocker flag on the corresponding Jira issue. Scrum masters see impediments updated in real time without manual triage.

useCases.title: Attach Zoom recording to Jira sprint
useCases.description: GAIA adds the Zoom recording URL as a link on the active Jira sprint board. Stakeholders can review any ceremony recording directly from Jira without asking for the link.

howItWorks.step: Connect Zoom and Jira to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Zoom account and Jira project. Map your recurring Zoom sprint meetings to the corresponding Jira boards and sprints.

howItWorks.step: Configure issue creation and update rules
howItWorks.description: Define which meeting types create new Jira issues, which update existing ones, and how GAIA should infer priority and assignee from meeting context.

howItWorks.step: GAIA logs meeting outcomes to Jira automatically
howItWorks.description: After each Zoom call, GAIA processes the summary and updates Jira accordingly. Sprint boards stay accurate and every commitment is traceable to the meeting where it was made.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work with Jira Software's sprint feature specifically?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA integrates with Jira Software and can add issues to the active sprint, update story status, and post sprint-level comments. It works with both company-managed and team-managed projects.

faqs.question: Can GAIA map different Zoom meetings to different Jira boards?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each recurring Zoom meeting can be mapped to a separate Jira board in GAIA's settings. Frontend standups post to the frontend board; backend planning posts to the backend board.

faqs.question: What happens if Zoom's meeting summary is incomplete?
faqs.answer: If the summary is sparse, GAIA falls back to the raw transcript to extract action items. You can also review GAIA's proposed Jira updates before they are applied if you prefer a human checkpoint.

zoom-hubspot.tagline: Log Zoom customer calls to HubSpot CRM and keep every deal updated
zoom-hubspot.metaTitle: Zoom + HubSpot Automation - Log Customer Calls to CRM
zoom-hubspot.metaDescription: Connect Zoom and HubSpot with GAIA. Auto-log Zoom customer calls to HubSpot contacts and deals, capture action items, and keep your CRM current after every call.
zoom-hubspot.intro:
Sales and customer success teams live in HubSpot, but their customer conversations happen in Zoom. Without an automatic bridge, call notes go un-logged, follow-up tasks get missed, and HubSpot deal timelines miss critical touchpoints that inform pipeline forecasting.

GAIA logs every Zoom customer call to the right HubSpot contact and deal automatically. Meeting summaries become CRM notes, action items become tasks, and deal stages update based on what was discussed — so your CRM reflects reality without manual data entry after every call.

useCases.title: Auto-log Zoom call summaries to HubSpot deals
useCases.description: When a Zoom customer call ends, GAIA creates a HubSpot activity log on the matching contact and deal. The summary includes attendees, key discussion points, and next steps.

useCases.title: Create HubSpot follow-up tasks from Zoom action items
useCases.description: Action items identified in a Zoom call summary become HubSpot tasks assigned to the account owner. Due dates from the conversation are applied so nothing slips post-call.

useCases.title: Update HubSpot deal stage based on call outcomes
useCases.description: If a Zoom call results in a verbal agreement or a scheduled demo, GAIA advances the HubSpot deal stage accordingly. Pipeline stages stay current without relying on reps to update manually.

useCases.title: Attach Zoom recording to HubSpot contact
useCases.description: GAIA attaches the Zoom recording URL to the HubSpot contact record. Sales managers can review calls directly from CRM without asking reps for links after the fact.

howItWorks.step: Connect Zoom and HubSpot to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Zoom account and HubSpot portal. GAIA matches Zoom meeting participants to HubSpot contacts by email address automatically.

howItWorks.step: Configure CRM logging preferences
howItWorks.description: Set which meeting types trigger CRM logging, how deal stage changes are inferred, and which HubSpot pipelines GAIA should update.

howItWorks.step: GAIA logs every customer call to HubSpot
howItWorks.description: After each Zoom call, GAIA creates the activity, tasks, and any deal stage updates in HubSpot. Your CRM is always current without post-call admin work.

faqs.question: How does GAIA match a Zoom meeting to the right HubSpot contact?
faqs.answer: GAIA matches participants by email address. If a Zoom participant's email exists as a HubSpot contact, the call is logged to that contact. Unmatched participants are flagged for manual review.

faqs.question: Can GAIA log calls to both a contact and an associated deal in HubSpot?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA logs the activity to the contact record and associates it with all open deals linked to that contact. You can configure it to target a specific pipeline if a contact has multiple deals.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work with HubSpot's free CRM or only paid tiers?
faqs.answer: GAIA works with any HubSpot tier that provides API access. The free CRM supports basic contact and activity logging. Task creation and deal stage updates require HubSpot Starter or above.

teams-slack.tagline: Bridge Teams and Slack for seamless dual-platform collaboration
teams-slack.metaTitle: Microsoft Teams + Slack Automation - Unified Team Comms
teams-slack.metaDescription: Connect Microsoft Teams and Slack with GAIA. Mirror messages across platforms, route alerts to the right tool, and keep dual-platform teams aligned automatically.
teams-slack.intro:
Organizations that have grown through acquisitions or departmental preferences often find themselves running both Microsoft Teams and Slack simultaneously. Messages sent in one platform go unseen by colleagues on the other, and critical decisions get siloed inside whichever tool a team happens to prefer.

GAIA bridges the gap by routing messages, alerts, and notifications between Teams and Slack automatically. Announcements posted in a Teams channel can be mirrored to the equivalent Slack channel, and Slack bot alerts can be forwarded to Teams so every stakeholder stays informed regardless of which platform they live in.

useCases.title: Mirror announcements across platforms
useCases.description: Company-wide announcements posted in Teams are automatically reposted to the corresponding Slack channel. Every employee sees the message in their preferred tool without the sender duplicating effort.

useCases.title: Route support alerts to the right platform
useCases.description: Monitoring alerts configured for Slack are forwarded to Teams channels where on-call engineers work. Incidents get the right eyes on them immediately regardless of platform preference.

useCases.title: Cross-platform meeting summaries
useCases.description: After a Teams meeting concludes, GAIA posts an AI-generated summary to the relevant Slack channel. Slack-native teammates stay in the loop without needing a Teams account.

useCases.title: Unified status updates
useCases.description: Project status messages from Slack workflows are mirrored into Teams project channels. Leadership teams using Teams always have current project visibility.

howItWorks.step: Connect Microsoft Teams and Slack to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Teams tenant and Slack workspace in a few clicks. GAIA securely stores credentials and begins monitoring both platforms.

howItWorks.step: Configure channel mappings and routing rules
howItWorks.description: Specify which Teams channels map to which Slack channels and set filters for message types, keywords, or senders to route. GAIA applies your rules without syncing noise.

howItWorks.step: GAIA automates cross-platform messaging
howItWorks.description: Messages matching your rules are formatted and posted to the target platform in real time. GAIA attributes the source clearly so recipients know where the message originated.

faqs.question: Will GAIA create an infinite loop of mirrored messages?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA tags mirrored messages internally and skips re-processing them. Only original messages trigger cross-platform forwarding.

faqs.question: Can I filter which messages get mirrored?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can restrict mirroring to specific channels, message types, or keywords. GAIA gives you granular control so only meaningful content crosses platforms.

faqs.question: Does this work with private channels?
faqs.answer: GAIA can access private channels in both platforms if granted the appropriate permissions during setup. You control which channels are in scope.

teams-notion.tagline: Save Teams meeting notes and decisions to Notion automatically
teams-notion.metaTitle: Microsoft Teams + Notion Automation - Meeting Notes to Docs
teams-notion.metaDescription: Connect Microsoft Teams and Notion with GAIA. Auto-save meeting summaries, decisions, and action items from Teams to structured Notion pages.
teams-notion.intro:
Microsoft Teams hosts hundreds of meetings every week, but the knowledge shared in those calls rarely makes it into a searchable, organized format. Meeting notes live in someone's local document or get lost in chat history, making it nearly impossible to recall decisions or action items weeks later.

GAIA automatically captures Teams meeting summaries and posts them as structured Notion pages. Action items become tasks in your Notion project database, and key decisions are logged with context so your team builds an institutional knowledge base with zero manual effort.

useCases.title: Auto-generate meeting notes in Notion
useCases.description: After every Teams meeting, GAIA creates a Notion page with an AI-generated summary, attendees, and key discussion points. Teams accumulate a searchable archive of every conversation.

useCases.title: Capture action items as Notion tasks
useCases.description: Action items discussed in Teams meetings are extracted by GAIA and added as tasks in the linked Notion database with assignees and due dates pre-filled.

useCases.title: Log decisions to a Notion decision register
useCases.description: Decisions made during Teams calls are logged to a dedicated Notion database with date, context, and owner. Teams build an auditable record of how and why decisions were made.

useCases.title: Post Teams channel highlights to Notion
useCases.description: Pinned messages and important threads from Teams channels are summarized and saved to the relevant Notion project page, keeping documentation current without manual copy-pasting.

howItWorks.step: Connect Microsoft Teams and Notion to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Teams tenant and Notion workspace. GAIA gains access to meeting transcripts and your target Notion databases.

howItWorks.step: Configure Notion templates and mappings
howItWorks.description: Select which Notion databases receive meeting notes, tasks, and decisions. GAIA uses your existing templates so new pages match your documentation style.

howItWorks.step: GAIA automates post-meeting documentation
howItWorks.description: When a Teams meeting ends, GAIA processes the transcript, populates the Notion page, and notifies attendees with a link. Documentation is done before anyone leaves the call.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require Teams transcription to be enabled?
faqs.answer: Yes, Teams meeting transcription must be enabled in your tenant for GAIA to process meeting content. GAIA works with the transcript data Teams generates.

faqs.question: Can I customize the Notion page structure?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA supports custom Notion templates so the generated pages match your team's existing documentation format including properties, sections, and linked databases.

faqs.question: How quickly does the Notion page appear after a meeting?
faqs.answer: GAIA typically creates the Notion page within a few minutes of the meeting ending, once the Teams transcript is processed and available.

teams-github.tagline: Get GitHub PR and issue notifications directly in Teams channels
teams-github.metaTitle: Microsoft Teams + GitHub Automation - Dev Alerts in Teams
teams-github.metaDescription: Connect Microsoft Teams and GitHub with GAIA. Post pull request updates, issue alerts, and CI status to Teams channels and keep your engineering team informed.
teams-github.intro:
Engineering teams that use Microsoft Teams for communication need GitHub activity to surface in their chat, not buried in email notifications or the GitHub web interface. Pull requests waiting for review, failing CI pipelines, and new issue reports all require fast human attention that email simply cannot deliver.

GAIA connects GitHub to Microsoft Teams so every relevant event — PR opened, review requested, CI failed, issue labeled — appears as a formatted Teams message in the right channel. Engineers spend less time checking GitHub manually and more time shipping code.

useCases.title: Pull request review notifications
useCases.description: When a PR is opened or a review is requested, GAIA posts a formatted card to the Teams engineering channel with the PR title, author, and a direct link. Reviewers see requests immediately.

useCases.title: CI/CD pipeline failure alerts
useCases.description: Failed GitHub Actions runs trigger an instant Teams alert with the workflow name, failing step, and branch. The on-call engineer can act within seconds of a pipeline breaking.

useCases.title: Issue triage notifications
useCases.description: New GitHub issues labeled 'bug' or 'urgent' are posted to the Teams support channel automatically. Triage happens in Teams without requiring everyone to monitor GitHub directly.

useCases.title: Release and deployment announcements
useCases.description: When a GitHub release is published, GAIA posts the release notes to the Teams product channel. The whole team is informed the moment a new version ships.

howItWorks.step: Connect Microsoft Teams and GitHub to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Teams tenant and GitHub organization. GAIA sets up webhooks on the repositories you select.

howItWorks.step: Map repositories to Teams channels
howItWorks.description: Specify which repositories send notifications to which Teams channels and which event types to include. GAIA filters noise so only meaningful events reach your team.

howItWorks.step: GAIA automates GitHub-to-Teams notifications
howItWorks.description: GitHub events matching your rules are formatted into rich Teams adaptive cards and posted in real time. Engineers get full context without leaving Teams.

faqs.question: Can I choose which GitHub events trigger Teams messages?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA lets you select from events including PR opened, PR merged, review requested, CI failure, issue created, and release published. You control the signal-to-noise ratio.

faqs.question: Can different repos post to different Teams channels?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each repository can be mapped to a separate Teams channel. For example, frontend PRs go to #frontend and infrastructure alerts go to #ops.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support GitHub Enterprise?
faqs.answer: GAIA es compatible con GitHub Enterprise además de GitHub.com. Indica tu nombre de host de Enterprise durante la configuración y GAIA se conecta a tu instancia de GitHub Enterprise Server.

teams-google-calendar.metaDescription: Conecta Microsoft Teams y Google Calendar con GAIA. Sincroniza reuniones bidireccionalmente, evita dobles reservas y mantén tu horario unificado en ambas plataformas.
keywords: Flujo de trabajo Teams Google Calendar
teams-google-calendar.intro:
Muchos profesionales viven en Google Calendar para la programación personal mientras que su empleador utiliza Microsoft Teams para las reuniones. El resultado es un calendario fragmentado donde las invitaciones a reuniones de Teams y los eventos de Google Calendar existen en silos separados, lo que facilita la doble reserva o la pérdida de reuniones por completo.

GAIA sincroniza reuniones de Microsoft Teams con Google Calendar bidireccionalmente. Las nuevas reuniones de Teams aparecen en Google Calendar automáticamente, y los eventos de Google Calendar pueden generar la creación de reuniones de Teams con el enlace de unión correcto. Tu horario siempre está unificado en el calendario que prefieres usar.

useCases.title: Agenda diaria de ambos calendarios
useCases.description: Cada mañana, GAIA compila tus reuniones de Teams y eventos de Google Calendar en una agenda unificada publicada en tu chat de Teams. Comienzas el día con un horario completo.

useCases.title: Recordatorios de reuniones a través de mensajes de Teams
useCases.description: GAIA envía un recordatorio de mensaje de Teams 10 minutos antes de los eventos de Google Calendar que no tienen contraparte en Teams, para que nunca te pierdas una reunión externa mientras trabajas en Teams.

drive-asana.intro:
Asana tasks often reference documents stored in Google Drive, but linking them manually is tedious and easy to forget. Team members end up hunting through Drive to find the brief, spec, or design file associated with a task they're working on, wasting time that should go toward actual work.

GAIA connects Google Drive and Asana so relevant files are attached to tasks automatically. When a new Asana project is created, GAIA builds the matching Drive folder structure. When a Drive document changes, GAIA updates the linked Asana task to flag the revision. Files and tasks stay connected throughout the project lifecycle.

useCases.title: Flag document revisions on Asana tasks

useCases.title: Compile project deliverables in Drive at completion

figma-asana.tagline: Link Figma design deliverables to Asana tasks automatically
figma-asana.metaTitle: Figma + Asana Automation - Design Handoffs in Task Management
figma-asana.metaDescription: Connect Figma and Asana with GAIA. Link Figma design files to Asana tasks, update task status when designs are ready, and streamline design-to-development handoffs.
figma-asana.intro:
Design handoffs are a perennial pain point between design and engineering teams. Designers mark a Figma file ready, but the corresponding Asana task for the engineer remains untouched. Engineers start development with no indication that the design has been finalized, or they build from an outdated version.

GAIA connects Figma and Asana to automate the handoff. When a Figma design moves to 'Ready for Development,' the linked Asana task is updated, the design file is attached, and the assignee is notified. The design-to-development handoff happens automatically with zero manual coordination.

useCases.title: Auto-update Asana tasks when designs are ready
useCases.description: When a Figma frame is tagged 'Ready for Development,' GAIA updates the linked Asana task status and notifies the assigned engineer. Handoffs are instant and automatic.

useCases.title: Attach Figma file links to Asana tasks
useCases.description: When a Figma file is created for a feature, GAIA attaches the Figma link to the corresponding Asana task. Engineers always have direct access to the latest designs from the task.

useCases.title: Create Asana tasks from Figma comment action items
useCases.description: When a comment in Figma is marked as a revision request, GAIA creates an Asana task for the designer with the comment text and frame link. No revision gets lost in comment threads.

useCases.title: Design milestone progress in Asana
useCases.description: As Figma frames progress through design stages, GAIA updates the Asana project milestone completion percentage. Project managers see design progress in their existing tool.

howItWorks.step: Connect Figma and Asana to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Figma account and Asana workspace. GAIA links your Figma projects to their corresponding Asana projects.

howItWorks.step: Map Figma status tags to Asana task states
howItWorks.description: Define how Figma status labels correspond to Asana task sections and custom fields. GAIA translates design workflow stages into project management language.

howItWorks.step: GAIA automates design handoffs and task updates
howItWorks.description: Figma status changes trigger Asana task updates, file attachments, and assignee notifications. Handoffs are complete before anyone sends a single message.

faqs.question: How does GAIA know which Figma file corresponds to which Asana task?
faqs.answer: You configure the mapping during setup by linking Figma projects to Asana projects. GAIA then matches files and frames to tasks based on naming conventions or custom tags you define.

faqs.question: Can GAIA handle multiple design revisions on the same Asana task?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each time a new Figma version is published, GAIA appends a comment to the Asana task with the version number and link. The full revision history is visible on the task.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work with Figma components and libraries?
faqs.answer: GAIA focuses on Figma files and frames rather than component libraries. Handoff automation applies to design files associated with specific product features in Asana.

stripe-slack.tagline: Get payment alerts, MRR updates, and churn notifications in Slack
stripe-slack.metaTitle: Stripe + Slack Automation - Revenue Alerts in Team Chat
stripe-slack.metaDescription: Connect Stripe and Slack with GAIA. Post payment notifications, MRR milestones, failed charge alerts, and churn warnings to Slack channels automatically.
stripe-slack.intro:
Revenue events happen in Stripe but the team learns about them through manual dashboard checks or end-of-month reports. Failed payments go unnoticed for days, churn happens silently, and MRR milestones are celebrated after the fact instead of in real time when the energy is highest.

GAIA connects Stripe to Slack so every meaningful revenue event surfaces immediately in the right channel. New subscriptions ring the virtual sales bell, failed charges alert the support team instantly, and MRR milestone posts keep the whole company motivated and informed without anyone opening the Stripe dashboard.

useCases.title: New subscription and payment notifications
useCases.description: Every new Stripe subscription triggers a Slack message in the sales channel with the customer name and plan. The team celebrates wins in real time as they happen.

useCases.title: Failed payment alerts for immediate recovery
useCases.description: Failed charges post an instant Slack alert to the support channel with the customer, amount, and failure reason. Recovery outreach begins within minutes instead of days.

useCases.title: MRR milestone announcements
useCases.description: When MRR crosses a milestone threshold, GAIA posts a company-wide Slack announcement. Revenue milestones are celebrated the moment they are achieved.

useCases.title: Churn and cancellation alerts
useCases.description: Subscription cancellations trigger a Slack alert to the customer success team with churn reason if available. Retention outreach can begin immediately after a cancellation.

howItWorks.step: Connect Stripe and Slack to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Stripe account and Slack workspace. GAIA listens to Stripe webhook events and routes them to your configured channels.

howItWorks.step: Configure event types and channel routing
howItWorks.description: Choose which Stripe events post to which Slack channels and set thresholds for MRR milestone alerts. GAIA gives you per-event control over routing.

howItWorks.step: GAIA automates revenue event notifications
howItWorks.description: Stripe events matching your rules are formatted into clear Slack messages with relevant customer and amount details posted in real time.

faqs.question: Can I set custom MRR milestone thresholds?
faqs.answer: Yes. You configure any MRR values that should trigger a Slack announcement. GAIA tracks cumulative MRR and posts when your defined thresholds are crossed.

faqs.question: Does GAIA expose sensitive customer data in Slack messages?
faqs.answer: GAIA lets you control which data fields appear in Slack notifications. You can include customer name and amount while omitting payment method details to protect sensitive information.

faqs.question: Can GAIA send Stripe alerts to different Slack channels by plan type?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can route enterprise plan events to one channel and startup plan events to another. GAIA supports conditional routing based on Stripe metadata fields.

stripe-notion.tagline: Build revenue dashboards and track payments inside Notion databases
stripe-notion.metaTitle: Stripe + Notion Automation - Revenue Data in Your Docs
stripe-notion.metaDescription: Connect Stripe and Notion with GAIA. Sync Stripe payment data to Notion databases, build revenue dashboards, and track subscriptions alongside your business documentation.
stripe-notion.intro:
Business operators often want revenue data alongside their strategy documents, customer notes, and planning databases in Notion, but Stripe data is locked inside the Stripe dashboard. Building manual revenue reports in Notion means exporting CSVs and copy-pasting numbers that are outdated the moment they are entered.

GAIA connects Stripe to Notion so revenue data flows automatically into your Notion databases. New subscriptions create records in your customer database, payment events update revenue tracking tables, and MRR figures refresh daily. Your Notion workspace becomes a live business intelligence hub without any manual data entry.

useCases.title: Auto-create customer records from Stripe subscriptions
useCases.description: When a new Stripe subscription is created, GAIA adds a record to your Notion customer database with plan, MRR contribution, and start date. Your CRM stays current automatically.

useCases.title: Live MRR and revenue tracking in Notion
useCases.description: GAIA updates a Notion revenue dashboard daily with current MRR, new revenue, and churn figures pulled from Stripe. Leadership has live revenue metrics without touching the Stripe dashboard.

useCases.title: Payment event log in Notion
useCases.description: Successful payments and failed charges are logged to a Notion database with date, customer, and amount. Finance teams have a searchable, filterable payment history inside Notion.

useCases.title: Subscription change tracking
useCases.description: Upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations in Stripe trigger updates to the Notion customer record. The subscription history for every customer is always current in your Notion CRM.

howItWorks.step: Connect Stripe and Notion to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Stripe account and Notion workspace. GAIA maps Stripe event types to your Notion database schemas.

howItWorks.step: Configure Notion database mappings
howItWorks.description: Define which Notion databases receive customer records, payment logs, and revenue metrics. GAIA uses your existing database properties to populate data correctly.

howItWorks.step: GAIA automates Stripe-to-Notion data sync
howItWorks.description: Stripe events create and update Notion records in real time. Revenue data, customer status, and payment history stay current without manual exports.

faqs.question: Can GAIA backfill historical Stripe data into Notion?
faqs.answer: Yes. During setup, GAIA can import existing Stripe customers and past payment records into Notion so your database starts populated with historical data.

faqs.question: How frequently does GAIA update the Notion revenue dashboard?
faqs.answer: GAIA updates the dashboard on a schedule you configure — hourly, daily, or on every Stripe event. Real-time updates are available for critical metrics like new subscriptions.

faqs.question: Is sensitive billing data stored in Notion?
faqs.answer: GAIA lets you choose which Stripe fields to sync to Notion. Payment method details and full card numbers are never synced — only business-relevant data like plan and amount.

airtable-google-sheets.intro:
Airtable es donde vive el trabajo estructurado: pipelines, inventarios, calendarios de contenido, seguimiento de candidatos. Pero los directivos, los clientes y los equipos de finanzas viven en Google Sheets. Hoy el puente entre ambos es una exportación manual a CSV que se queda obsoleta en cuanto se descarga, además del caos de versiones cuando cinco personas anotan cinco copias distintas.

GAIA mantiene Airtable y Google Sheets sincronizados sin exportaciones. Los registros nuevos o modificados en Airtable aparecen automáticamente como filas en la hoja correcta, con las columnas asignadas a tus campos. Los cambios también pueden ir en sentido contrario: las ediciones en Sheets se escriben de vuelta en los registros de Airtable, de modo que la hoja se convierte en un espacio de edición seguro para quienes nunca abren Airtable.

Los informes se simplifican de paso. Crea tablas dinámicas, gráficos y paneles en Sheets sobre datos que se actualizan solos, mientras Airtable sigue siendo el sistema de referencia con sus vistas, permisos y registros vinculados intactos.

howItWorks.step: Conecta Airtable y Google Sheets a GAIA
howItWorks.description: Autoriza a GAIA con tu cuenta de Airtable y tu cuenta de Google. Elige las bases que GAIA puede leer y las hojas de cálculo en las que puede escribir.

howItWorks.step: Asigna bases, vistas y campos a hojas
howItWorks.description: Elige qué vista de Airtable se sincroniza con qué pestaña de la hoja y empareja campos con columnas. GAIA escribe los registros vinculados como nombres legibles, no como ID de registro.

howItWorks.step: GAIA sincroniza filas y registros de forma continua
howItWorks.description: Las altas, las actualizaciones y las instantáneas programadas se ejecutan solas. GAIA empareja filas y registros mediante un campo clave para que las actualizaciones nunca creen duplicados.

useCases.title: Añade los nuevos registros de Airtable como filas
useCases.description: Cuando se crea un registro en Airtable, ya sea por un formulario, una automatización o un compañero, GAIA lo añade como fila en la hoja de Google asignada, con cada campo en su columna. Los flujos de entrada siguen visibles para quienes solo usan hojas.

useCases.title: Sincroniza los cambios en las filas existentes
useCases.description: Cuando cambia un campo de estado, responsable o fecha en Airtable, GAIA actualiza la fila correspondiente en lugar de duplicarla. Las hojas reflejan siempre el estado actual de la base.

useCases.title: Registra respuestas de formularios para revisarlas
useCases.description: Los envíos de formularios de Airtable llegan a una hoja de revisión donde los compañeros sin licencia de Airtable pueden clasificar, comentar y aprobar. Las filas aprobadas se escriben de vuelta en Airtable con una sola confirmación.

useCases.title: Instantáneas programadas para informes
useCases.description: GAIA exporta una instantánea con fecha y hora de una vista según tu calendario: pipeline diario, inventario semanal, candidatos mensuales. Cada instantánea llega como una pestaña fechada, así que representar tendencias es trivial.

useCases.title: Crea paneles en vivo con datos sincronizados
useCases.description: Apunta los gráficos y tablas dinámicas de Sheets a la pestaña sincronizada y se actualizarán a medida que cambie Airtable. La dirección tiene sus paneles sin licencias extra, inicios de sesión ni exportaciones obsoletas.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo sincronizo Airtable con Google Sheets automáticamente?
faqs.answer: Conecta ambas herramientas a GAIA, elige la vista de Airtable y la pestaña de destino, y asigna los campos a las columnas una sola vez. Los registros nuevos se añaden como filas y los cambios en los campos actualizan la fila correspondiente, sin más exportaciones.

faqs.question: ¿GAIA actualiza las filas existentes o solo añade nuevas?
faqs.answer: Ambas cosas. GAIA empareja las filas con los registros de Airtable mediante un campo clave que eliges, como el ID del registro o el correo. Los registros nuevos añaden filas nuevas, y los cambios en registros existentes actualizan la fila emparejada en su sitio.

faqs.question: ¿Puedo sincronizar solo una vista filtrada de Airtable en lugar de toda la base?
faqs.answer: Sí. Indica a GAIA una vista concreta y solo se sincronizarán con Sheets los registros que cumplan sus filtros. Distintas vistas pueden alimentar distintas pestañas para públicos diferentes.

faqs.question: ¿Las ediciones en Google Sheets pueden actualizar registros de Airtable?
faqs.answer: Sí. Con la sincronización bidireccional activada mediante disparadores, las ediciones en las columnas asignadas se escriben de vuelta en el registro de Airtable correspondiente. Tú decides qué columnas son editables para proteger las fórmulas y los rollups.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo aparecen en Sheets los registros vinculados y los adjuntos?
faqs.answer: Los registros vinculados se sincronizan como nombres legibles, no como crípticos ID de registro, y GAIA puede incluir las URL de los adjuntos en una columna dedicada. Los rollups y las fórmulas se sincronizan con su valor calculado en el momento de la sincronización.

google-docs-slack.intro:
Los borradores viven en Google Docs, las decisiones se toman en Slack y los dos rara vez se encuentran bien. Los enlaces pegados en el chat chocan con muros de solicitud de acceso, los comentarios se dispersan en hilos que nunca llegan al documento y las fechas de revisión se retrasan porque nadie sabe que el documento ha cambiado.

GAIA conecta Google Docs y Slack para que los documentos se muevan a la velocidad del chat. Pide a GAIA que comparta un documento y comprobará que los miembros del canal tienen acceso antes de publicarlo, corrigiendo primero los permisos. Los comentarios, las sugerencias y las ediciones llegan como avisos de Slack en el canal adecuado, y los hilos de Slack pueden convertirse en documentos con un solo comando.

Está pensado para equipos que revisan juntos especificaciones, propuestas y publicaciones: quienes escriben siguen trabajando en Docs mientras los demás implicados siguen el proceso, aprueban y comentan desde Slack sin aprender una herramienta nueva.

howItWorks.step: Conecta Google Docs y Slack a GAIA
howItWorks.description: Autoriza a GAIA con tu cuenta de Google y tu espacio de trabajo de Slack. GAIA obtiene permisos de lectura, escritura y uso compartido en Docs, además de permiso para publicar en Slack.

howItWorks.step: Elige los documentos vigilados y los canales de aviso
howItWorks.description: Indica a GAIA qué documentos o carpetas de Drive debe vigilar y qué canales reciben los avisos. Define quién puede conceder acceso cuando GAIA comparte.

howItWorks.step: GAIA comparte, vigila y redacta por ti
howItWorks.description: Los documentos se comparten con los permisos comprobados, los comentarios llegan como avisos y se crean documentos nuevos desde el chat cuando lo pides. Documentos y conversación siguen vinculados.

useCases.title: Comparte documentos con los permisos resueltos
useCases.description: Cuando pides a GAIA que publique un documento en un canal, verifica que todos los miembros pueden abrirlo y les concede antes acceso de lectura o de comentario. Se acabaron los callejones sin salida de solicitar acceso.

useCases.title: Avisos de comentarios y sugerencias en Slack
useCases.description: Los comentarios nuevos, las respuestas y los hilos resueltos de los documentos vigilados se publican en el canal responsable con un enlace directo. Los revisores responden en horas, no en días.

useCases.title: Crea documentos a partir de hilos de Slack
useCases.description: Una decisión tomada en un hilo largo se convierte en un resumen, una especificación o un acta de reunión en Drive con un solo comando. GAIA redacta a partir del hilo y publica el enlace de vuelta.

useCases.title: Recordatorios de fechas de revisión
useCases.description: Los documentos pendientes de revisión reciben recordatorios amables y programados en Slack hasta que llegan los comentarios o el responsable da el visto bueno. Nada se queda esperando en silencio.

useCases.title: Encuentra cualquier documento sin salir de Slack
useCases.description: Pide a GAIA un documento por nombre, cliente o tema y recibe al momento un enlace con los permisos comprobados. El conocimiento del equipo queda a un mensaje de distancia.

faqs.question: ¿Todos los miembros del canal podrán abrir un documento compartido?
faqs.answer: Sí. GAIA comprueba el acceso de los miembros del canal antes de publicar y concede el permiso de lectura o de comentario que hayas configurado. Si tu política bloquea el uso compartido externo, GAIA te dice quién queda excluido en lugar de publicar un enlace roto.

faqs.question: ¿Puedo recibir avisos en Slack de los comentarios de Google Docs?
faqs.answer: Sí. GAIA vigila los documentos que elijas y publica los comentarios nuevos, las respuestas y la actividad de sugerencias en el canal asignado, con un enlace directo al hilo.

faqs.question: ¿Puede GAIA crear un documento de Google a partir de una conversación de Slack?
faqs.answer: Sí. Indica a GAIA un hilo y redactará un documento a partir de la conversación, lo guardará en la carpeta de Drive que elijas y publicará el enlace de vuelta en el canal.

faqs.question: ¿Funciona con documentos en unidades compartidas?
faqs.answer: Sí. GAIA admite documentos en unidades compartidas y en Mi unidad, respetando los mismos permisos de carpeta que ya aplica tu espacio de trabajo.

faqs.question: ¿Puede GAIA limitar quién recibe los avisos de documentos?
faqs.answer: Sí. Los avisos se dirigen por documento o por carpeta al canal que elijas, y puedes limitar los avisos de comentarios a menciones de personas concretas o solo a hilos sin resolver.

todoist-google-sheets.intro:
Todoist sabe lo que has terminado, pero demostrarlo implica capturas de pantalla o registros manuales. Los responsables piden resúmenes semanales, los freelancers necesitan registros de tareas facturables y los equipos quieren datos de tiempo de ciclo, todo encerrado en la lista de tareas.

GAIA lleva Todoist a Google Sheets automáticamente. Las tareas completadas se añaden a una hoja de registro con los campos de proyecto, etiquetas, fechas y prioridad, listas para tablas dinámicas. También funciona al revés: las filas añadidas a una hoja, como nuevos leads, ideas de contenido o informes de errores, se convierten en tareas de Todoist con los campos asignados a títulos, proyectos y fechas de vencimiento.

El resultado es una capa de análisis personal sobre Todoist y una vía de carga masiva para el trabajo capturado en cualquier otro lugar. Tu lista de tareas sigue siendo donde ocurre el trabajo, y Sheets pasa a ser donde se mide.

howItWorks.step: Conecta Todoist y Google Sheets a GAIA
howItWorks.description: Autoriza a GAIA con tu cuenta de Todoist y tu cuenta de Google. Elige qué proyectos se registran en Sheets y qué pestañas crean tareas.

howItWorks.step: Asigna los campos a las columnas una sola vez
howItWorks.description: Empareja campos de Todoist como proyecto, etiquetas, prioridad y fecha de vencimiento con columnas de la hoja. GAIA recuerda la asignación en cada sincronización futura.

howItWorks.step: GAIA registra las tareas completadas y crea tareas
howItWorks.description: Las tareas terminadas se añaden solas al registro, mientras las nuevas filas de la hoja llegan a Todoist como tareas. Ambos sentidos funcionan sin que tengas que vigilarlos.

useCases.title: Registra automáticamente las tareas completadas en Sheets
useCases.description: Cada tarea completada llega a una hoja de registro con su proyecto, etiquetas, fecha de vencimiento y hora de finalización. Las hojas de horas y los informes semanales se escriben solos.

useCases.title: Resúmenes semanales de productividad
useCases.description: GAIA agrupa el registro en una pestaña semanal: tareas completadas por proyecto, pendientes vencidos que se arrastran y rachas actuales. Compártelo con tu responsable o guárdalo para ti.

useCases.title: Crea tareas a partir de filas de la hoja
useCases.description: Las nuevas filas de una pestaña vigilada se convierten en tareas de Todoist con las columnas asignadas a título, proyecto, prioridad y fecha de vencimiento. Los calendarios de contenido y las listas de leads se convierten directamente en acción.

useCases.title: Compara estimaciones con el tiempo real
useCases.description: Registra por tarea los datos estimados frente a los reales y representa en Sheets la precisión a lo largo del tiempo. La planificación mejora de forma medible cada trimestre.

useCases.title: Importa backlogs en bloque desde hojas de cálculo
useCases.description: ¿Vienes de otra herramienta o planificas un proyecto en Sheets? GAIA convierte cada fila en una tarea en el proyecto correcto, conservando el orden, las etiquetas y las fechas.

faqs.question: ¿Puede GAIA registrar automáticamente mis tareas completadas de Todoist?
faqs.answer: Sí. Conecta Todoist y elige una hoja de cálculo de registro. Cada tarea completada añade una fila con proyecto, etiquetas, fechas y prioridad, para que tu historial se construya solo.

faqs.question: ¿Qué campos de Todoist aparecen en la hoja?
faqs.answer: Título de la tarea, proyecto, sección, etiquetas, prioridad, fecha de vencimiento, fecha de creación y hora de finalización. Eliges el orden de las columnas una vez y GAIA lo mantiene en cada fila.

faqs.question: ¿Las nuevas filas de Google Sheets pueden convertirse en tareas de Todoist?
faqs.answer: Sí. Asigna las columnas a los campos de la tarea y cada fila nueva crea una tarea en el proyecto que elijas, con la prioridad y la fecha de vencimiento tomadas de los valores de la hoja.

faqs.question: ¿Puedo registrar solo algunos proyectos y no todo?
faqs.answer: Sí. Selecciona exactamente qué proyectos de Todoist alimentan el registro. Las tareas personales se quedan privadas mientras los proyectos de trabajo se sincronizan para los informes.

faqs.question: ¿GAIA gestiona las tareas recurrentes en el registro?
faqs.answer: Sí. Cada vez que completas una tarea recurrente se registra una fila propia con sus fechas, así que las rachas y el análisis de frecuencia siguen siendo precisos.
